# Prime Radiant

> *"The Prime Radiant can show the equations of the Psychohistory in all their mathematical beauty."*
> — Isaac Asimov, Foundation Series

**Prime Radiant** is a swarm intelligence simulation engine that lets you upload any unstructured document — a report, article, or scenario description — and simulate emergent social dynamics across thousands of AI agents to discover how events unfold.

---

## Origins

This project began as an English port of **[MiroFish](https://github.com/666ghj/MiroFish)**, a Chinese open-source swarm simulation framework built on [OASIS](https://github.com/camel-ai/oasis) and [Zep](https://www.getzep.com/).

The original MiroFish project is the work of its authors and contributors. Prime Radiant started as a translation and Next.js modernization of MiroFish's frontend, with the Python/Flask backend translated to English and progressively refactored.

> **Note:** The translation of the backend and original logic may be incomplete or contain bugs introduced during porting. If you encounter issues or inaccuracies, contributions are very welcome — please open an issue or pull request.

**Prime Radiant is diverging from MiroFish** and will eventually become its own independent project with its own roadmap, architecture decisions, and feature direction.

---

## Architecture

```
prime-radiant/          ← Next.js 16 frontend (this repo)
backend/                ← Python/Flask backend (translated from MiroFish)
```

The frontend proxies all `/api/*` calls to the Flask backend running on `localhost:5001`.

### Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS |
| State | Zustand |
| Backend | Python 3.11+, Flask 3, Flask-CORS |
| LLM | OpenAI-compatible API (configurable endpoint) |
| Memory / Graph | Zep Cloud |
| Simulation | OASIS (camel-ai), camel-oasis |
| Document Parsing | PyMuPDF, unstructured |

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Backend

```bash
cd backend
uv sync
```

Create `backend/../.env` (at the repo root):

```env
LLM_API_KEY=your_llm_api_key
LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
LLM_MODEL_NAME=gpt-4o-mini
ZEP_API_KEY=your_zep_cloud_api_key
```

Start the backend:

```bash
uv run python run.py
# Runs on http://localhost:5001
```

### 2. Frontend

```bash
cd prime-radiant
pnpm install
pnpm dev
# Runs on http://localhost:3000
```

---

## How It Works

1. **Upload** — Drop in a PDF, Markdown, or text document describing a real-world scenario
2. **Ontology Generation** — The LLM extracts entity types and relationship types from the document
3. **Graph Build** — A knowledge graph is constructed in Zep from the extracted entities
4. **Simulation** — OASIS runs a multi-agent social media simulation (Twitter/Reddit-style) seeded from the graph
5. **Report** — A ReportAgent synthesizes findings and answers natural language queries
6. **Deep Interaction** — Chat with any simulated agent or query the ReportAgent directly

---

## Relationship to MiroFish

| Aspect | MiroFish | Prime Radiant |
|---|---|---|
| Language | Chinese UI + backend | English throughout |
| Frontend | Vue | Next.js 16 (App Router) |
| Backend | Flask (Chinese) | Flask (English, refactored) |
| Status | Stable v0.1 | Active development |

---

## Roadmap

Prime Radiant is diverging significantly from MiroFish:

- [ ] Replace Zep Cloud with an embedded graph database for RAG (no external dependency)
- [ ] Rewrite backend in a full-stack TypeScript framework (e.g. Next.js API routes or a Node-native server) to eliminate the Python service

- Named after the mathematical device from Isaac Asimov's *Foundation* series
